text: This report summarizes the discussions at the Tenant Liaison meeting held in person on December 11, 2025, at Enercare Centre. Kelvin Seow, Chief People and Strategy Officer, led the meeting, co-hosted by Mr. Howard Lichtman of the Board of Governors of Exhibition Place. Thirteen tenant representatives, Exhibition Place staff, and representatives from the City's FIFA Secretariat were in attendance.
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Received the report (January 19, 2026) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place, for information.
